All 6 returned exactly one row by slug (zero by destination_key, since destination_key is null on all 6 rows today) - see source-snapshots/{slug}-supabase.json for verbatim results. No write, RPC, or mutation of any kind was performed. Records were not automatically merged with the destinations.ts snapshots.
statusFieldNote: The agreed status vocabulary (migrated, enriched, display_ready, scoring_ready) has no defined value for a destination that has not yet begun migration. Per the Phase 5A instructions, no new status vocabulary is introduced here. Every row's "status" is explicitly null (not a string), meaning: not yet migrated. This is not the same as an omitted/missing field - it is a deliberate, explicit representation of the pre-migration state using the existing four-value design's absence, not a fifth invented value.
